scope: Source-backed candidate atomic plans for all eval modules; not executable AtomicProgram definitions or observed trajectory labels.

pick.definition: Force-bearing finger/object grasp followed by supported lift; bind arm/contact region.
pick.current_support: Explicit geometry-independent same-arm two-finger contact-held motion interval, full native lift within the current held interval and current hold at endpoint implemented for rigid pick. Offline regression coverage; new live verification, broader force closure and grasp-stability calibration still needed.

place.definition: Held object approaches target, is released, settles with intended containment/support.
place.current_support: supported_release now tracks held transport, all-finger release, upward support and consecutive bounded pose changes. Prototype stack_blocks_by_language binding and offline counterexamples; asset calibration and live validation remain.

push.definition: Robot/object contact co-occurs with object motion while intended table support persists.
push.current_support: Explicit geometry-independent finger/contact-held planar motion with named upward force-bearing scene-table/object support each sampled step implemented. Offline regression coverage; new live verification, independent stroke segmentation and palm contacts still needed.

push_with_tool.definition: Held tool active surface contacts selected objects and causes displacement.
push_with_tool.current_support: held_tool_push now requires sustained tool grasp, simultaneous tool/target contact, support and new planar tool/target motion. Prototype align_blocks binding and offline counterexamples; active-edge calibration and live validation remain.

pour.definition: Selected material exits source and enters target with residue/spill accounting.
pour.current_support: rigid_material_transfer now tracks initially contained source contents, held/tilted source exit, whole-rigid-object target entry and raw counts in explicitly calibrated convex interior volumes. Offline only; existing ball program not migrated, liquid particle/mass adapter missing.

actuate.definition: Robot contacts moving mechanism link and causes calibrated joint transition.
actuate.current_support: contact_joint_motion now reads live DOF state and its actual USD moving-body contact, with directed travel during a contact interval. Offline counterexamples; per-control joint/sign/limits binding, moving-link geometry selectors and live validation remain.

twist.definition: Gripped part rotates about intended constrained axis with engagement maintained.
twist.current_support: contact_constrained_twist now accumulates signed substep rotation with held part/target contact, configured pivot depth/radius and bounded off-axis rotation. Offline counterexamples; calibrated part-root/pivot, thread engagement/progress and live validation remain.

insert.definition: Tip/hole crosses opening/peg with fit, axis alignment and bounded signed depth.
insert.current_support: held_insertion now recognizes an aligned held-tip path from outside a live opening into signed bounded depth with target contact. Offline counterexamples; task-specific hole/peg/tip fit calibration, existing program migration and live validation remain.

touch_with_tool.definition: Held tool tip physically impacts intended target then separates for next strike.
touch_with_tool.current_support: held_tool_contact now requires held tool, new contact after separation, named active body/collider suffixes and impulse. Offline counterexamples; actual tip/key bindings, impact velocity/rebound/timing and live validation remain.

handover.definition: Giver hold precedes receiver hold, giver release and continued receiver support.
handover.current_support: grip_transfer now tracks giver-only hold, sustained overlap, actual giver release and continued receiver-only hold with bounded per-step displacement. Offline counterexamples; named task-arm bindings and live validation remain.

fold.definition: Grasped material region moves across crease; layers align and remain after release.
